```python
def get_shape(val: Any) ->Optional[List[int]]:
    try:
        return list(val.type().sizes())
    except (AttributeError, RuntimeError):
        return None


def linear_flop_jit(inputs: List[Any], outputs: List[Any]) ->Number:
    input_shape = get_shape(inputs[0])
    weight_shape = get_shape(inputs[1])
    assert len(input_shape) >= 2, input_shape
    assert len(weight_shape) == 2, weight_shape
    output_dim, input_dim = weight_shape
    batch_size = prod(input_shape[:-1])
    flops = batch_size * input_dim * output_dim
    return flops
```
